neighbours.label: recipe-step 'add': the verb (Add / add / Ajouter / añadir) that introduces the next ingredient in cooking instructions

notes: Card: peaks ' Add', ' add', 'outer' (ajouter), 'adir' (añadir) in recipes; weaker on next-step verbs in game walkthroughs. Probes: recipe Add 0.85 / add 0.67 / Ajouter 0.49; non-recipe 'add the numbers' 0.03; walkthrough 0.22, UI steps 0.16. Near misses keep cooking topic or the word add, not both.
